sites.why: rule 4: streamObject with a model from lib/models.ts getModelClient(llm, config); for the openai/anthropic providers createOpenAI/createAnthropic({apiKey}) use the vendor default endpoint, but apiKey is config.apiKey from the request body (user-entered key in chat settings, getClientApiKey) with env fallback. Same call also dispatches at runtime to google/mistral/groq/together/fireworks/xai/deepseek/ollama/vertex (other vendors, rule 2 for those branches). rule 4: generateObject via the same getModelClient(llm, config) multi-provider dispatch as /api/chat; OpenAI/Anthropic branches use the default endpoint with the caller's config.apiKey from the request when provided. Other providers' branches go to other vendors (rule 2).

rule 2: generateText on createOpenAI({baseURL: 'https://api.morphllm.com/v1'}) - Morph's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a different vendor; key is MORPH_API_KEY (the apiKey parameter is never passed by its only caller).
